NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: This app accesses your photo library so you can pick photos for your gear and backpack cards.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This app accesses your photo library to save shared images.
NSCameraUsageDescription: This app uses the camera to take photos of your gear.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to load the current position of your trip destination.
NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Reads workouts recorded during your trip (distance, elevation, route) to show them in your backpack. Data stays on your device and is never sent to our servers.
